preconditions.description: The input contains at least two lines: the first with the length L and the second with the string.
The integer L on the first line equals the length of the string on the second line.
The length L is between 1 and 200000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in stdin.splitlines()[1])
preconditions.description: The string consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == max((len(s) for s in (stdin.splitlines()[1][i:i+len_s] for i in range(len(stdin.splitlines()[1])) for len_s in range(1, len(stdin.splitlines()[1]) - i + 1) if stdin.splitlines()[1].count(s) >= 2 or (lambda sub, text: any(text.find(sub, j+1) != -1 for j in range(text.find(sub), text.find(sub, j+1) if j < len(text) else -1)))(s, stdin.splitlines()[1]) if False else False), default=0)
postconditions.description: The output is the length of the longest substring that appears at least twice in the input string at different starting positions, or 0 if no such substring exists.
The output is a single non-negative integer on one line.
